scope: Qualify each integrated job-board application route only from its own exact captured posting, matching company-source record, configured collector identity, provider, tenant, and persisted APPLICATION_REDIRECT capability. Rank that evidence above aggregators and below verified employer or ATS routes, and explain it in the route picker.

environment.frontend: local Vite production build and connected Chromium
environment.delivery: local-only; no push; hosted automation and review disabled

checks.evidence: Tests verify exact captured-posting/source/configuration links, multi-source canonical jobs, fail-closed evidence mismatches, aggregator < trusted board < verified ATS ranking, explicit route selection, profile preference readback, and connected browser rendering. The browser test observed no external requests or submissions.
TypeScript check and Vite production build passed; existing advisory reports a generated JavaScript chunk above 500 kB.

checks.command: python -m py_compile services/dedupe/routes.py tests/integration/test_application_route_trust.py tests/browser/test_application_route_preference.py; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate; git diff --check

not_run: Hosted Actions, hosted reviews, or external certification (NOT_RUN_BY_USER_POLICY)
limitations: PostgreSQL-specific behavior and the full repository test suite were not run; the focused API workflow used isolated SQLite and connected local Chromium.
The supported board trust allowlist currently contains Remotive, Remote OK, and We Work Remotely source adapters; other providers remain aggregator or unknown until explicitly supported.
safety: Route authority is derived from a matching captured posting, company source, configured collector, provider, tenant, and APPLICATION_REDIRECT capability; provider labels or quality scores alone never establish trust.
Verified employer and ATS evidence remain above trusted boards. Users retain explicit route selection and the USER_CHOICE policy.
No real external requests, application submissions, or private user documents were used.
